basic_info.description: Beautifully Renovated & Expanded Single-Family Home with Private Roof Deck in the Heart of Nob Hill! Located just 3 blocks from vibrant North Beach & Jackson Square, this inviting 3-level home offers the perfect blend of charm, functionality & modern updates. With 3-4 bedrooms and 3 full baths (one on each level) this home is designed for comfort & versatility. Main level: large LR/DR combo highlighted by an oversized picture window. The kitchen was completely redesigned with custom cabinetry, an induction stove, Bosch dishwasher, and direct access to a small deck with BBQ. On the lower level is a large flexible bonus room & bath with soaring ceilings and a built-in desk that can be used as a home office, guest suite, or additional (4th) bedroom. On the top floor, a cozy sitting area leads to the beautiful private roof deck with approx. 495 sqft, complete with a greenhouse & plenty of space for seating and entertaining. The large garage accommodates 2 cars & offers ample space for a workshop & add'l storage. Current owners expanded the original home by adding 2 full baths, flex room, and roof deck incl. seismic & structural upgrades. Nearby is the Central Subway w/ CalTrain & BART connections. Enjoy easy access to the Embarcadero, North Beach, Downtown, and Jackson Square!
